acceptance_criteria.criterion: parseOutcomeSummary() extracts the text content between ### Outcome Summary and the next ### heading (or end of file).
When ### Outcome Summary is absent, the function falls back to the first bullet of ### Implementation Summary.
When both sections are absent, the function returns null (not an error).
The function handles edge cases: empty section content, extra whitespace, multiple paragraphs in the section.
Unit tests cover all four scenarios (present, fallback, absent, malformed).
